title: 💬  To optimize the performance of the system using the provided rules, we need to arrange the symbols in the following order: DABC. This arrangement satisfies all the rules and results in the best possible performance for each symbol.

messages.content:
## Instructions
Arrange the symbols in the optimal order.

### System

The system relies on a unique set of four symbols, and it is only valid when all symbols are used exactly once. The order of symbols determines the system's performance.

### Symbols and Performance

| Symbol | Performance Rule |
| ------ | ---------------- |
| A | Best performance when not followed by more than one symbol. |
| B | Best performance when not preceded by symbol A or C. |
| C | Best performance when it is not the last symbol. |
| D | Best performance when it is the first symbol. |

The challenge is to arrange these symbols (A, B, C, D) in a sequence that maximizes their performance based on the given rules.

Based on the provided information, we can create an arrangement for the symbols A, B, C, and D that optimally meets the specified conditions. Here's the best possible arrangement:

D - A - B - C

Explanation:
- D is placed at the beginning because it has the best performance when it is the first symbol.
- A follows D because its performance is best when not followed by more than one symbol. Placing B between A and C ensures that A is not followed by two symbols (C).
- B comes after A because its performance is best when not preceded by either symbol A or C. Since A is already before B, placing C after B satisfies this condition.
- Finally, C is placed at the end because its performance is best when it is not the last symbol. By placing D at the very beginning, C does not become the final symbol in the sequence.
